links.outcome: Flesch Reading Ease of chatbot cancer responses with vs without sixth-grade-level prompt
links.effect: Prompting raised median reading ease in free (52.60 to 71.55) and paywalled (62.48 to 75.64) chatbot versions, both P < .001, without significant change in DISCERN quality.
links.quote: Prompting was associated with increases in reading ease in both free (median [IQR], 71.55 [68.20-78.99]; P < .001)and paywalled versions (median [IQR], 75.64 [70.53-81.12]; P < .001).

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses with explicit sixth-grade reading level instruction
links.effect: Asking for a sixth grade reading level increased median Flesch scores to 71.55 (free) and 75.64 (paywalled), both P < .001; DISCERN quality did not differ.
links.quote: However, prompting the free chatbot to reword responses at a sixth grade reading level was associated with increased reading ease scores than the paywalled chatbot nonprompted responses (median [IQR], 71.55 [68.20-78.99]) (P < .001).

unlisted_practices: Teaching the public to prompt chatbots for plain-language output to promote equitable access
